_comment: Baseline interface spec for the stream contract. Regenerate with scripts/check-interface.sh --update after intentional public interface changes.

functions.name: get_protocol_fee_config
functions.doc: Returns the current protocol fee configuration as (fee_bps, treasury), or None when fees are disabled. Read-only.

functions.name: archive_stream
functions.doc: Archives a completed stream, moving its secondary index entries out of persistent storage to reduce rent. No query regressions; archived streams remain resolvable via the archive path.
